description: This source file contains the implementation of the class ModifyAttributeLiveCommandImpl, which is an immutable class extending AbstractModifyLiveCommand and implementing ModifyAttributeLiveCommand. It encapsulates the logic for a live command to modify an attribute, including methods to access attribute pointer and value, set headers, and create answer builders.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of {@link ModifyAttributeLiveCommand}, providing functionality to modify a specific attribute in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of {@code ModifyAttributeLiveCommandImpl} from a generic Command object, casting it to ModifyAttribute.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer indicating the attribute's location.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the JsonValue representing the new value for the attribute.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified DittoHeaders, modifying the command's headers context.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command modifies authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object, including class name and superclass information.
